item.title: Team Fortress 2 Update Released
item.description:
An update to Team Fortress 2 has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart Team Fortress 2. The major changes include:
  • Updated cp_wildcat_event to fix missing model for Spies disguised as pumpkins
  • Updated/Added some tournament medals

item.title: Team Fortress 2 Update Released
item.description:
An update to Team Fortress 2 has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart Team Fortress 2. The major changes include:
  • Fixed smoke effect regression for Le Sapeur
  • Updated the Chief Executor, Vested Investor's Vest, and Standing Offer to fix clipping issues
  • Updated cp_wildcat_event
    • Added +1 minute to the round timer
    • Fixed a bug that allowed pumpkin-disguised players to cap at 15x speed
    • Fixed pumpkin-disguised players not displaying as Ubercharged if they have a Voodoo-Cursed Soul cosmetic equipped
    • Fixed buildings being able to be built inside the shutter door in the connector between A and B
    • Fixed some jack-o-lanterns around the map not rendering during the waiting for players period
    • Fixed equipped Powerup Canteens rendering while pumpkin-disguised
  • Updated Updated zi_atoll, zi_blazehattan, zi_devastation_final1, zi_murky, zi_sanitarium, and zi_woods
    • Lowered edicts across the board
    • Zombie Sniper's Spit now deals critical hits to airborne targets
    • Fixed Zombie Engineer building status being visible upon initial infection
    • Fixed Reveal outline persisting on players into the next round
  • Updated zi_atoll (additional changes)
    • Fixed a visual bug where water would disappear in certain parts of the map
    • Added more cover in front of the shack
    • Enabled every BLU spawn point no matter where RED players are located

item.title: Operation: Europa
item.description:
(Image Credit: Entropy Tempus, Arma and LazerSofa)

Legend speaks of a forgotten place that holds untold riches, somewhere across the pond, where we need to establish control... Now it's time to visit this "Old World", again...


Welcome to Europe!


Operation: Europa is a map-focused community project that aims to bring European environments to TF2! There are so many places to go and see! We can't reasonably cover them all on our own, so the Operation: Europa Team calls on you, the community, to make your European maps for the project and help bring an authentic European experience to TF2!


Additionally, they are collaborating with TF2Maps.net to bring you a Major Mapping Contest centered around Europe! If you think you have what it takes, read up on the contest thread below to familiarize yourself with the rules.


It's not just maps, though! While maps are important for navigation, especially in a place like Europe, what's even more important? Style of course! A place as rich as Europe provides many opportunities for unique garments to dress yourself with so you blend right in! The project is also looking for cosmetics, war paints, Unusual effects, and anything else that can be submitted to the Workshop!
